trusted_execution.automated_validation: actual complete owned CMD results; default all declared command exits equal zero, or explicit structured conditions including expected nonzero
trusted_execution.command: actual owned receipt and exit code authenticate historical results even when declared input contents have changed; current VAL separately rechecks current inputs
trusted_execution.modified_files: actual modified project files must be recorded and verified
trusted_execution.file_version: producer-owned ordered publication lineage plus declared concrete input fingerprints; changed content requires revalidation

ai_review.references: 1..64 concrete artifact path/hash/detail, owned command record_id/finished_sha256/detail, or retained change transaction_identity/path/before_sha256/after_sha256/detail
ai_review.verification: recheck actual source bytes, receipt ownership and retained complete publication; empty labels do not pass

manual.input: confirmation: project-relative path and sha256 of the actual user JSON document
manual.binding: exact designated user and record-begin validation_context; frozen raw bytes and document retained
manual.identity: source provenance is explicit; does not authenticate same-user peers cryptographically; AI must not invent user statements

trusted_execution.source: assigned from formal kind: automated=procedure, ai_review=ai_review, manual=user_confirmation

skipped.binding: exact approved non-blocking skip_record; no fabricated result; never satisfies necessary validation
